content: The soul is healed by being with children.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
story:
Standing before a firing squad in Semyonov Square in 1849 before a last-second reprieve commuted his sentence to four years of hard labor in Siberia, Dostoevsky stared directly into death. Enduring epilepsy, grief, and grinding poverty, he descended into the darkest labyrinths of the human soul, discovering that redemption and faith are only forged through deep suffering.

In formulating this reflection, Fyodor Dostoevsky stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of healing. For Fyodor Dostoevsky, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
